amendment_boundary: No HI1 Coworld episode or runtime result existed before this amendment. RCI tightened causal attribution, provenance, latency, reach, and identity gates without inspecting outcomes.
authority_amendment_boundary: No HI1 Coworld episode or runtime result existed before this amendment. Final integration RCI found that a pre-run formal APPROVE would falsely assert local_matched before measurement. This amendment follows the proven C4 split: a pushed Odin advisory records an already-active Hrafn diagnostic window, while the campaign's sole formal approval remains reserved for a later post-evidence promotion cross-audit.
source_revision_boundary: No HI1 Coworld episode or runtime result used the superseded f9d569a1 image or request. Odin source review required the decision adapter to accept unrelated root metadata while projecting only legalActions and observation for selector and auditor input.

parent.label: hrafn-fylking:v5
parent.control_contract: Both arms run the same safety and public-text wrapper around the literal exact-v5 selector. The wrapper removes unsafe actions, quick_chat, emoji, and untrusted internal marker fields. The sole arm difference is HRAFN_INTENT_ENABLED=0 versus 1, which controls whether a validated intent may restrict the executor's affordance set.

hypothesis.claim: A small strategic intent with bounded lifetime can improve Hrafn's opening conversion while the exact-v5 executor retains action-ID choice, timing, commitment, retry behavior, and K1Z safety.
hypothesis.mechanism: The planner chooses only grow or convert, an exact visible outsider ID when converting, and a horizon. It never receives or returns legal action IDs, action kinds, percentages, weights, labels, or free-form instructions. The common wrapper applies safety and public-text filtering. The executor then filters to intent-compatible affordances and runs the literal exact-v5 selector unchanged on that subset.
hypothesis.expected_causal_trace: An accepted intent is causal only when the chosen exact action ID differs from the same-input wrapped exact-v5 baseline. Such decisions expose the hi1 sidecar marker and a structured log row containing both IDs.

schema.targetID: null for grow; exact visible outsider player ID for convert

planner.refresh_rule: Start in wrapped exact-v5 mode. Refresh in the background after a committed action when no valid intent exists or its decision horizon expires; never delay an action response for planning. Reject a plan older than 12 committed decisions and use decision-count exponential retry backoff after failures.
planner.prewarm: Before each candidate episode, call the pinned model with the exact response schema, verify the returned model name, query the local Ollama model inventory for the pinned digest, and record the probe and Ollama version in the episode preflight receipt.

validation: Reject unknown or extra fields, unknown objectives, noninteger or out-of-range horizons, and nonexact target IDs.
grow requires targetID null and at least one current neutral growth affordance.
convert requires an alive, visible, nonallied, non-K1Z target with a current exact-v5 conversion affordance.
Reject stale, unavailable, protected, ambiguous, or unresolved targets and fall back to the same-input exact-v5 action.
Spawn, K1Z alliance, Odin support, and severe-defense decisions remain outside intent authority.
Both arms remove quick_chat and emoji before selection and strip policyMarker, intentMarker, requestMarker, and campaignStartDecision from every wire action.

Every committed fresh request keeps an unbounded match-lifetime semantic cache over the projected legalActions and observation; changed projected semantics under a reused request ID fail closed, while unrelated root metadata is accepted and discarded.
intent_contract.public_marker: hi1 appears only when a valid intent changes the exact selected action ID from the same-input wrapped exact-v5 baseline. Every response also carries q plus the first 10 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256(requestID), allowing a strict policy-log to replay join without exposing the request ID.

red_first_tests: Intent disabled, missing, malformed, expired, or unreachable preserves the wrapped exact-v5 action and policy marker across frozen fixtures; the q10 request sidecar is common to both arms.
grow and convert can each cause a fresh legal action-ID delta on a reachable fixture.
convert binds to one exact outsider ID; K1Z, allied, unknown, ambiguous, and unavailable targets cannot be selected.
Intent cannot override spawn, K1Z alliance, Odin support, or severe defense.
hi1 is absent without an action-ID delta and present exactly once with a delta.
Planner timeout, malformed output, and transport failure keep response selection on exact-v5 and emit truthful degradation telemetry.
No candidate response contains an ID outside the current legal menu.
A planner result older than 12 committed decisions, an intent that becomes unreachable, and an immediate retry after planner failure are rejected and truthfully logged.
The request cache retains at least 520 decisions and rejects changed action semantics under a duplicate request ID.

A plain-object decision envelope with unrelated root metadata is accepted, while selector and auditor telemetry contains a structured clone of only legalActions and observation; missing or malformed required fields fail closed.
Untrusted legal-action fields cannot forge policy, hi1, or request markers.
required: Focused HI1 tests and the complete repository test suite pass.
Exact-v5 compatibility is compared against the frozen 0c151570 implementation over the full strategy fixture corpus.
A linux/amd64 image is built from an exact committed source tree and its digest is recorded.

A machine-readable image receipt binds the subject digest, full source commit, linux/amd64 platform, executable and dependency smoke checks, container-to-Ollama schema probe, passing test gate, pinned model digest, exact preregistration bytes, and exact-v5 opponent digest.
No qd1n or Odin source, image, process, identity, submission, or champion state is modified or run.

pilot.design: Four separate same-seat 4-player FFA episodes; candidate and control never play each other. Each cell freezes map, seed, subject slot, names, commands, limits, and three outsider opponents. The only arm difference is intent enabled versus disabled for the subject named exactly K1Z Hrafn.
pilot.opponents: Three fixed outsider names running the exact v5 rebuild. No Odin or qd1n image is permitted.
pilot.identity_window_required: Before any Coworld episode, Odin first switches the shared active identity to exactly K1Z Hrafn and commits one valid advisory identity-window receipt binding the exact source commit, image digest, image receipt, four job hashes, preregistration file/content hashes, model digest, ordered diagnostic scope, and Hrafn-only lane. The advisory has formal_approval=false and mutation_scope=none; it records coordination and does not consume or impersonate the campaign's one formal approval. Preflight independently verifies the already-active Hrafn identity.
pilot.job_provenance: Each job is generated by scripts/build-hrafn-intent-job.mjs from the pinned manifest and a matching subject image receipt. The subject image differs from the exact-v5 outsider image. Pair comparison must prove the jobs differ only at players[subject_slot].env.HRAFN_INTENT_ENABLED from 0 to 1.
pilot.execution: Each episode runs through scripts/proxywar-runner-lease.sh with a foreground scripts/run-hrafn-supervised.mjs process and a direct uvx coworld==0.1.28 run-episode command. Preflight must enforce the exact order Pangaea control, Pangaea candidate, clean Pangaea pair audit, Asia candidate, Asia control by hash-binding every predecessor operational receipt and the Pangaea continuation verdict. A preflight receipt records the full argv, job SHA-256, image digests, source commit, container-side model probe, active identity, lease state, output directory, and predecessor evidence before dispatch.
pilot.evidence_join: scripts/audit-hrafn-intent-pair.mjs must join every fresh nonspawn Hrafn policy row one-to-one with its replay row through the q10 request marker, independently replay the wrapped exact-v5 baseline from the recorded structured clone containing only legalActions and observation, prove both selected and baseline IDs were legal, bind the live preregistration bytes to the committed image-receipt file hash, and fail on missing, duplicate, ambiguous, degraded, fallback, rejected, held, disconnected, or K1Z-harm rows.

primary_metric.name: opening_auc20
primary_metric.definition: Arithmetic mean of auditAfter.tilesOwned over the subject's first 20 fresh, accepted, external, nonspawn decisions after strict policy-log to replay joining. Fewer than 20 observations fail closed unless the replay, final state, and results all verify elimination; only then are the missing suffix observations padded with zero.
primary_metric.pass: Candidate lift is positive in both paired cells and mean relative lift is at least 10 percent.

pilot.outcome_veto: Candidate combined final score and combined final tiles must each be at least control.

autonomy_reach.denominator: All fresh, joined, nonspawn candidate decisions, including pre-plan exact-v5 decisions.

reliability.pretreatment_equivalence: Before the candidate's first hi1 delta, control and candidate must have identical turn, selected action, selected metadata, legal-menu shape, and normalized pre-action state at every decision.

pilot.sequential_stop: Audit the Pangaea pair before Asia. Stop on a safety or reliability failure, intent coverage below 80 percent, or fewer than eight action deltas in a surviving candidate. Do not stop for performance alone if the pair is operationally clean.

verdicts.PROMISING_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: Primary metric, outcome veto, reach, and reliability all pass. Expand to at least three seeds per map before any promotion packet.
verdicts.REJECT_NO_REACH: Intent did not produce the preregistered valid coverage and action deltas.
verdicts.REJECT_SAFETY_OR_RELIABILITY: Any fail-closed safety or operational gate failed.
verdicts.REJECT_NO_LIFT: Reach was real but the paired primary metric or outcome veto failed.

authorization.allowed_now: Hrafn-only source, tests, exact image build, local planner probes, preregistration, advisory mailbox coordination, and the four local diagnostic episodes only after the advisory identity window and every preflight gate pass.
authorization.blocked_until_one_exact_odin_approval: Any upload, submission, placement, membership change, or champion mutation. The sole formal Odin APPROVE may be requested only after matched local evidence and all required expanded, hosted, regression, safety, and fail-closed gates exist; it must bind the final evidence and remains the only Odin approval for this campaign.
authorization.blocked_until_all_promotion_gates: Upload, submission, placement, membership change, or champion mutation even if an advisory diagnostic window exists.
